mentions.name: sel4-rs
mentions.description: A hand port of the SeL4 microkernel to Rust, undertaken to learn how kernels and capabilities work. The project currently has a stub that boots the CPU into 64-bit x86_64 mode and runs Rust code, with work in progress on locating the root process via multiboot for memory setup. It is a for-fun/learning project rather than an attempt to improve on the formally verified C implementation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've spent the last week starting to hand port SeL4 to rust. Mostly because I want to learn how kernels & capabilities work.
